The probe raised on the first post-epoch music request (the shared contract's acceptBgm treats a second BGM as contamination) and probe_runtime exits the BizHawk client before re-raising, so the capture looked like a clean self-termination at frame 3219. v3 ends the window at that request deliberately. references.recorder_probe_note: probe carries v2's two dispatch hooks (Sound_PlaySFX PC $721C6 and Sound_PlaySpecial PC $7230C) and adds the window rule: the capture closes at the first post-epoch Sound_PlayBGM request instead of a fixed frame budget, because the single-song normalization contract (one song's ROM asset range on the reference side, one music sequencer in S1OpenGgfSfxAudioCapture) cannot describe the ROM after Sound_PlayBGM reloads driver RAM. In this movie that request is bgm_Invincible ($87, _Constants.asm:344) at frame 3219, from the GHZ1 invincibility monitor; the invocation carrying it is discarded. 90 dispatches recorded in this window vs 81 in v2. Hook failures are now appended to <OGGF_OUT>.error before the client exits, and run_s1_audio_parity.sh fails the capture on a non-empty sidecar.
